:::{#def-rao-blackwellized}
#### Rao--Blackwellized estimator

Let $\hparam$ be an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\param$,
and let $\statf{\vX}$ be a [sufficient](#def-sufficient) statistic for $\param$.
The **Rao--Blackwellized estimator** is the conditional expectation of $\hparam$ given the statistic:

$$
\hparam_{\mathrm{RB}} \eqdef \condE{\hparam}{\statf{\vX}}
$$ {#eq-rao-blackwellized}

:::
